title: item_spoken
description: Phone to hub, once welcomed: the `item` with this `id` has been said, so the hub stops sending it. A phone that gets an Item it has already said (its `item_spoken` was lost with a connection) sends `item_spoken` again instead of saying it twice. The hub ignores an `id` it does not know.

id.description: The `id` of the item that was said.
